_comment: Othello locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate coordinates, the piece letters B/W, the move format '[row, col]', or the ASCII board. Anchor terminology to the sibling board games (board, valid moves, wins, draw).

_slots.{colour}: The player's rendered colour name (Black / White)
_slots.{piece}: The player's piece letter, either B or W (do not translate)
_slots.{board}: The pre-rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{valid}: The pre-rendered valid-moves / no-valid-moves line (may be empty)
_slots.{moves}: Neutral comma-separated list of legal moves like '[2, 3]', '[3, 2]' (do not translate)
_slots.{valid_list}: Neutral Python-list repr of the legal moves (do not translate)
_slots.{black}: Number of Black pieces on the board
_slots.{white}: Number of White pieces on the board
_slots.{r}: The row coordinate of the played move (do not translate)
_slots.{c}: The column coordinate of the played move (do not translate)
_slots.{flipped}: Number of opponent pieces flipped by the move

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing {colour} ({piece}) in a game of Othello.
Your goal is to have more pieces of your color on the board by the end of the game.
On your turn, place a piece such that it flanks one or more of your opponent's pieces-in any direction (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal)-between your new piece and another of your existing pieces. All flanked opponent pieces will be flipped to your color.
Provide your move in the format '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_skip: No valid moves - you may have to skip.
board.no_valid_moves_skip_endash: No valid moves – you may have to skip.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move must be of the form [row, col].

game_action.skip_turn: Player {pid} had to skip their turn

game_message.must_skip: Player {pid} ({piece}) has no valid moves and must skip.
